other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a widow (girl/woman).
The beneficiary must be a citizen of India and a resident of West Bengal.
The beneficiary must have been a resident of West Bengal for at least ten years on the date of application.
The beneficiary must not be maintained by any of her relatives.
Professional beggars and mendicants are not eligible for the pension.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
